io.name: clk
io.description: Clock; all D flip-flops trigger on the negative edge.

io.name: reset
io.description: Active high synchronous reset; resets all flip-flops to 0x34.

io.name: d
io.description: Data input to the 8 D flip-flops.

io.name: q
io.description: Registered output of the 8 D flip-flops.

functional_summary.overview: Eight D flip-flops triggered on the negative edge of clk, with active high synchronous reset that loads 0x34 into all flip-flops instead of zero.
rules: On the negative edge of clk, if reset is high, q is synchronously loaded with 0x34.
On the negative edge of clk, if reset is low, q is loaded with d.
q holds its value between negative clock edges.
Reset is synchronous and active high, sampled on the negative edge of clk.
